name: strata-toolchain
description: The Strata compiler as tools an agent can call: structured diagnostics with the error taxonomy attached, the schema of a project, and what a column rename would break before it is made.

strata_root.title: Strata checkout
strata_root.description: The absolute path of the Strata checkout to serve. It must hold both bin/strata and ERROR_TAXONOMY.json; a directory with only one of them is a half-copied tree and is refused. One checkout per session: this is fixed when the server starts.

strata_llm_model.title: Model name for strata_ask_model
strata_llm_model.description: Passed through untouched to the endpoint below. Leave empty and strata_ask_model refuses rather than picking one, because a default model is a bill nobody agreed to. Every other tool works without it.

strata_llm_url.title: Chat-completions endpoint for strata_ask_model
strata_llm_url.description: Any service that speaks the chat-completions shape. Leave empty for http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions, a model server on this machine, so that forgetting this sends nothing anywhere.

strata_llm_key.title: API key for strata_ask_model
strata_llm_key.description: Held in this machine's credential store and handed to the server as an environment variable. It is never a tool argument, never written to a file, and never appears in a tool result. Leave empty and strata_ask_model refuses with a message naming it; nothing else is affected.
